services.lede: Each service has a fixed scope, a fixed fee and a launch date, agreed in writing before we begin. Use one, or let them work together.

items.label: 01 — PREMIUM WEBSITES
items.heading: A first impression worth the business behind it.
items.intro: Before anyone calls, they look you up. We write and design a site that makes you look established from the first click, and that turns visitors into customers.

points.title: Strategy and copy
points.text: We learn your business, your customers and their requirements, then write every page around them.

points.title: Bespoke design
points.text: No templates. A visual identity on the web that looks like your business at its best.

points.title: Fast, mobile-first build
points.text: Fast on every phone, accessible to every visitor and ready for search from day one.

points.title: An admin you can use
points.text: Edit pages, products and posts yourself. Code, domain and hosting are in your name.

items.label: 02 — WEB SYSTEMS
items.heading: The working parts behind the site.
items.intro: Enquiry flows, catalogues, bookings, quote builders, client portals and dashboards: the parts that do real work every day, built to fit how you already run.

points.title: Quote and enquiry systems
points.text: Guided forms that collect what you need to price a job, then route it to the right person.

points.title: Catalogues and stores
points.text: Products, variants, stock and secure online payments, with an admin panel your team can run.

points.title: Bookings and portals
points.text: Appointments, reminders and a private area for clients to see orders, files and invoices.

points.title: Dashboards
points.text: The numbers you check every morning in one place, updated by themselves.

facts.label: Built for
facts.value: The way your team already works

items.label: 03 — AUTOMATIONS · NEW
items.heading: Handled before you even ask.
items.intro: We connect your website, WhatsApp, Instagram and email so every enquiry is captured, answered, qualified and followed up in seconds, while orders, invoices and stock stay in sync.

points.title: Lead capture and instant replies
points.text: Every channel in one place, with a friendly reply and timely follow-ups sent to each customer on your behalf, in your tone.

points.title: Qualification and CRM
points.text: Leads checked for budget, location and need, then logged and assigned in Google Sheets, HubSpot or the CRM you already use.

points.title: Follow-ups and owner alerts
points.text: Polite follow-ups until the buyer replies, and hot leads sent straight to your phone.

points.title: Orders, invoices and reports
points.text: Invoices, orders and stock synced between tools, with a weekly report that writes itself.

items.label: 04 — SEARCH OPTIMISATION (SEO)
items.heading: Found first, then measured.
items.intro: Search, Maps and AI answers, plus the steady refinements that keep a site earning, with a clear report every month.

points.title: Technical foundations
points.text: Speed, structure and indexing fixed so search engines can read every page.

points.title: Local and city pages
points.text: Google Business Profile and a strong page for every area you serve.

points.title: AI-answer visibility
points.text: Content structured so ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity can cite you.

points.title: Measurement and refinement
points.text: Enquiries, calls and orders tracked, and the pages that move them improved monthly.

faq.q: How much does a project cost?
faq.a: Every project gets a fixed fee in a written proposal after a short consultation, in US dollars or your local currency. You know the full price before we start.
Yes, and most clients do. A premium website brings enquiries, automations answer them, and search keeps new visitors arriving.
No. Anyone who does is guessing. We do the technical and content work properly and report what changed every month.

faq.q: Who owns the website and automations?
faq.a: You do. Code, domain, hosting and every workflow are in your name, with documentation and a walkthrough at handover.

story: WeberAct was started by a founder and co-founder who kept seeing the same thing: good businesses judged by websites that didn't do them justice, and enquiries lost because nobody had time to reply.
So we build the opposite. Websites that make a business look as established as it really is, the systems behind them, and the automations that answer every enquiry in seconds.
Every project begins with a promise in writing: a fixed scope, a fixed fee and a date you can plan around. Then we keep it.
